sources.population: FOS examination 5 1991-1995 n=2473, predominantly white, age >=25, excludes diabetes treatment or FPG >=126 mg/dL but retains 44 diabetic two-hour glucose cases. sources.measurement: NGSP/DCCT-standardized HPLC HbA1c %, fasting plasma glucose hexokinase in mg/dL; FOS additionally two-hour glucose. Main-table spreads are SE, not individual SD. No conversions used.

sources.population: Maamu 2010-2012 Russian n=293, Somali n=184, Kurdish n=275; Health 2011 comparator n=653; ages 30-64 in six Finnish cities. Diabetes excluded using register/self-report/medication or HbA1c>=6.5% or glucose>=7. Complete cases and 4-17-hour fast. Weighted design; age binary 30-44 versus 45-64.
sources.measurement: Measured BMI kg/m^2; immunoturbidimetric HbA1c %, also mmol/mol; fasting glucose mmol/L in fluoride-citrate plasma for migrants and serum for comparator. Glucose models also adjust fasting duration. No unpublished 8% conversion adopted.
